So when he found the bottle tangled in kelp below the tower, green glass fogged with salt, his hands trembled as he worked the cork free. Elias resealed the bottle, carried it up the spiral stairs, and set it in the lamp room where the beam could pass through the glass, so that the light itself would keep delivering the message to every ship on the dark water.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市像一台尚未关机的机器，压低了声音运转。街灯把湿漉漉的马路照成一条发光的河，几辆出租车缓缓滑过，车灯划开薄雾。写字楼的玻璃幕墙上还亮着零星几盏灯，像不肯入睡的眼睛。便利店里灯光白得刺眼，夜班店员靠着收银台打盹。远处传来环卫车洒水的声音，梧桐叶上的露水一颗颗坠落。街角的早餐铺已经亮起第一盏灯，蒸笼里冒出细细的白汽。这是城市最安静的时刻——它在黎明之前，悄悄翻了个身。", "w03": "- Imagine looking at your reflection between two facing mirrors: you see a picture inside a picture inside a picture, going on and on.\n- Recursion is when something is defined by using a smaller copy of itself — like a story that contains a shorter version of the same story.\n- To keep it from going forever, you always need a bottom step that stops the copying, just like the smallest Russian nesting doll that doesn't open."}
